title: Variational Graph Neural Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2603.29515v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The increasingly wide use of deep machine learning techniques in computational mechanics has significantly accelerated simulations of problems that were considered unapproachable just a few years ago. However, in critical applications such as Digital Twins for engineering or medicine, fast responses are not enough; reliable results must also be provided. In certain cases, traditional deterministic methods may not be optimal as they do not provide a measure of confidence in their predictions or results, especially in inverse problems where the solution may not be unique or the initial data may not be entirely reliable due to the presence of noise, for instance. Classic deep neural networks also lack a clear measure to quantify the uncertainty of their predictions. translated_title: 用于逆问题不确定性量化的变分图神经网络
translated_abstract: 深度机器学习技术在计算力学中的日益广泛应用，显著加速了几年前还被认为难以处理的问题的仿真求解。然而，在工程或医学数字孪生等关键应用中，仅有快速响应是不够的，还必须提供可靠的结果。在某些情况下，传统的确定性方法可能并非最优，因为它们无法为其预测或结果提供置信度度量，尤其是在逆问题中——其解可能不唯一，或者初始数据可能由于噪声等因素而并非完全可靠。经典的深度神经网络同样缺乏量化其预测不确定性的明确度量。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种变分图神经网络（VGNN）架构，该架构将变分层集成到其结构中，以建模概率分布……
tldr: 本文提出一种将变分层集成到图神经网络中的VGNN架构，通过建模概率分布来量化逆问题中深度学习预测的不确定性，从而为计算力学中的关键应用提供可靠的置信度度量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variational graph neural network (VGNN) architecture that integrates variational layers to model probability distributions, enabling uncertainty quantification for deep learning predictions in inverse problems.
